title: Uma casa volta a ter energia
authorship: Controlled, manually authored renderer comparison. No new Gemini or TTS calls. Not an autonomous AI generation benchmark.

limits: Motion 2D and classic Toon use their existing drawing primitives and fixed poses, not a replacement renderer.
Their scene clock is mapped to three four-second beats; word captions are disabled because there is no spoken narration.
The same action labels and sound effects are added to the five exported clips in mastering.
Motion 2D, Toon and SVG use the shared fixed-frame encoder in a read-only test harness, rather than the old MediaRecorder UI.
Code 3D is explicitly imported into the existing isolated app player; it must pass the native replay gate.
All fixtures are experimental; this study changes no production renderer or published default.
